nodes.text: You're new. Nobody's new here. Where did you even come FROM?

Down. Right.

Muren says there is a whole country down there - marsh, then water, then us. I have never seen water I could not lift in a bucket. I would like to see the kind you cannot.

It matters to ME. I have met eleven people ever and four of them are dead.

So yes. It matters. Tell me one thing about outside and I will leave you alone.

choices.label: There is water you cannot lift.

nodes.text:
Then I will. Not yet - Ost would skin me and there is the cut to walk.

But I have decided, and I am telling you so that somebody outside this town knows I decided it.
